gotchas: Ask user questions with onecrew.ask_user_question and consume completed answers once. Answers clarify intent; they do not approve an unrelated downstream write.
Do not merge identities from display names alone.
Present result_ref for the user's App confirmation of the held payload without refetching, then read back saved Creators. Choice answers are not save authority.

Candidate explicit intent (add_new/save_or_update), target, connection, provenance, notes, tags and quality; batches use one intent and no candidate cache.

onecrew.creator.candidate.batch.save takes one candidates array, up to 50; the eight-call envelope and provider concurrency are separate limits.

Owner preparation reads fresh profiles and hubs, writes no Creator rows or reservations, and holds the immutable typed payload in the result owner.

gotchas: Ask user questions with onecrew.ask_user_question and consume completed answers once. Answers clarify intent; they do not approve an unrelated downstream write.
Do not merge identities from display names alone.
Present result_ref for the user's App confirmation of the held payload without refetching, then read back saved Creators. Choice answers are not save authority.

Owner statuses: eligible_new, eligible_update, existing_skipped, duplicate_skipped, identity_pending, contact_conflict, failed; count eligible_new toward a new Creator target.

onecrew.creator.candidate.batch.save takes one candidates array, up to 50; the eight-call envelope and provider concurrency are separate limits.

Owner preparation reads fresh profiles and hubs, writes no Creator rows or reservations, and holds the immutable typed payload in the result owner.

operations.summary: Ask for missing information or preferences needed for the next decision. Ask one to four questions with two to four suggestions each; support single selection, multiple selection, and custom text. toolkit_guides.connection_model: OneCrew records are local. Outreach derives its operator from the selected route or conversation; use each operation's exact input and connection contract.
gotchas: Ask user questions with onecrew.ask_user_question and consume completed answers once. Answers clarify intent; they do not approve an unrelated downstream write.
Do not merge identities from display names alone.
Present result_ref for the user's App confirmation of the held payload without refetching, then read back saved Creators. Choice answers are not save authority.
Each confirmation authorizes one frozen call. Batches reuse result_ref for later reviews and keep completed receipts; only final status resumes the model.
Only onecrew.creator.export XLSX is canonical; map CSV or other sheets into explicit onecrew.creator.batch.create items and reject missing or ambiguous fields.
Owner statuses: eligible_new, eligible_update, existing_skipped, duplicate_skipped, identity_pending, contact_conflict, failed; count eligible_new toward a new Creator target.
identifier_semantics: OneCrew record IDs are durable local identities and are not provider handles.
Candidate explicit intent (add_new/save_or_update), target, connection, provenance, notes, tags and quality; batches use one intent and no candidate cache.
Historical discovery and candidate IDs stay provenance; current reads return provider IDs. Use actual row_id values for reviews and outcomes.
onecrew.creator.candidate.batch.save takes one candidates array, up to 50; the eight-call envelope and provider concurrency are separate limits.
A link hub found in any profile is read with onecrew.link_hub.extract: links and emails return as found; nothing is saved until a Creator save confirms them.
Owner preparation reads fresh profiles and hubs, writes no Creator rows or reservations, and holds the immutable typed payload in the result owner.

operations.summary: Ask for missing information or preferences needed for the next decision. toolkit_guides.connection_model: Provider work uses a tagged X operator account. Browser login and reconnect are attended lifecycle steps; connection identity remains X-specific.
gotchas: Select x.posts.search.advanced and deduplicate authors before verification.
Read profile or recent posts only when quality or geography evidence is missing; otherwise pass locator, connection and provenance to Creator save preparation.
A post's language is not evidence that its author lives in that language's country. Keep requested geography and content-quality checks in the plan's acceptance criteria.
Search and thread reads return native X pages and cursors without creating Creator records or snapshots. Pass the native next_cursor unchanged to continue.
Do not substitute an Instagram handle or Creator ID for an X locator.
After network_unreachable, run x.connection.check once and report its status; do not retry the failed call until the check returns ok.
identifier_semantics: Handles identify X accounts; preserve the returned spelling when passing them to another X operation.
Post locators and account locators are different identifier domains.

Owner preparation reads fresh profiles and hubs, writes no Creator rows or reservations, and holds the immutable typed payload in the result owner.

toolkit_guides.connection_model: OneCrew records are local. Outreach derives its operator from the selected route or conversation; use each operation's exact input and connection contract.
gotchas: Ask user questions with onecrew.ask_user_question and consume completed answers once. Answers clarify intent; they do not approve an unrelated downstream write.
Do not merge identities from display names alone.
Present result_ref for the user's App confirmation of the held payload without refetching, then read back saved Creators. Choice answers are not save authority.
Each confirmation authorizes one frozen call. Batches reuse result_ref for later reviews and keep completed receipts; only final status resumes the model.
Only onecrew.creator.export XLSX is canonical; map CSV or other sheets into explicit onecrew.creator.batch.create items and reject missing or ambiguous fields.
Owner statuses: eligible_new, eligible_update, existing_skipped, duplicate_skipped, identity_pending, contact_conflict, failed; count eligible_new toward a new Creator target.
identifier_semantics: OneCrew record IDs are durable local identities and are not provider handles.
Candidate explicit intent (add_new/save_or_update), target, connection, provenance, notes, tags and quality; batches use one intent and no candidate cache.
Historical discovery and candidate IDs stay provenance; current reads return provider IDs. Use actual row_id values for reviews and outcomes.
onecrew.creator.candidate.batch.save takes one candidates array, up to 50; the eight-call envelope and provider concurrency are separate limits.
A link hub found in any profile is read with onecrew.link_hub.extract: links and emails return as found; nothing is saved until a Creator save confirms them.
Owner preparation reads fresh profiles and hubs, writes no Creator rows or reservations, and holds the immutable typed payload in the result owner.

operations.summary: Ask for missing information or preferences needed for the next decision. Do not merge identities from display names alone.
Present result_ref for the user's App confirmation of the held payload without refetching, then read back saved Creators. Choice answers are not save authority.
Each confirmation authorizes one frozen call. Batches reuse result_ref for later reviews and keep completed receipts; only final status resumes the model.
Only onecrew.creator.export XLSX is canonical; map CSV or other sheets into explicit onecrew.creator.batch.create items and reject missing or ambiguous fields.
Owner statuses: eligible_new, eligible_update, existing_skipped, duplicate_skipped, identity_pending, contact_conflict, failed; count eligible_new toward a new Creator target.

Owner preparation reads fresh profiles and hubs, writes no Creator rows or reservations, and holds the immutable typed payload in the result owner.

pitfalls: Do not confirm an unverified route merely because it was discovered.
steps: Pass the verified locator, connection and real provenance directly using the current save contract. The runtime reads fresh profile and link-hub data; present the returned result_ref and inspect the identity resolution and offered routes.
The user confirms only selected rows and routes in the App, then read back the Creator after completion.
workflow_hints.summary: Prepare fresh profile and link-hub data directly from a saved Creator's verified platform locator and explicitly confirm contact routes before treating them as durable facts.
workflow_hints.title: Confirm Creator Contact

pitfalls: Original discovery and candidate IDs are provenance, not cache keys. Preparation writes no Creator rows or reservations. Follow actual row_id values through the review and outcome.
steps: Use the current candidate-save input contract to pass the explicit per-candidate intent, target, connection, real provenance, notes, tags and quality directly; do not add a save-only prefetch; present the returned result_ref for review.
The user confirms rows and routes through the App-only onecrew_result_state action confirm_creator_save_batch; read back the saved Creator after completion.
workflow_hints.summary: Prepare and confirm saving one selected platform account as a Creator, then read it back.
workflow_hints.title: Save One Creator Candidate

pitfalls: Use the batch operation for more than one candidate; do not repeat onecrew.creator.candidate.save.
No Creator is persisted before explicit route confirmation.
steps: Fetch the current batch-save input contract and pass one candidates array with one consistent explicit intent plus target, connection, real provenance, notes, tags and quality per candidate; present the returned result_ref review.
The user confirms selected rows and contact routes through the App-only onecrew_result_state action confirm_creator_save_batch, then read back each saved Creator.
workflow_hints.summary: Prepare several selected candidates together, review their contact routes in one batch card, confirm selected rows, and read back the saved Creators.
workflow_hints.title: Save Creator Candidates in a Batch

toolkit_guides.connection_model: OneCrew records are local. Outreach derives its operator from the selected route or conversation; use each operation's exact input and connection contract.
gotchas: Ask user questions with onecrew.ask_user_question and consume completed answers once. Answers clarify intent; they do not approve an unrelated downstream write.
Do not merge identities from display names alone.
Present result_ref for the user's App confirmation of the held payload without refetching, then read back saved Creators. Choice answers are not save authority.
Each confirmation authorizes one frozen call. Batches reuse result_ref for later reviews and keep completed receipts; only final status resumes the model.
Only onecrew.creator.export XLSX is canonical; map CSV or other sheets into explicit onecrew.creator.batch.create items and reject missing or ambiguous fields.
Owner statuses: eligible_new, eligible_update, existing_skipped, duplicate_skipped, identity_pending, contact_conflict, failed; count eligible_new toward a new Creator target.
identifier_semantics: OneCrew record IDs are durable local identities and are not provider handles.
Candidate explicit intent (add_new/save_or_update), target, connection, provenance, notes, tags and quality; batches use one intent and no candidate cache.
Historical discovery and candidate IDs stay provenance; current reads return provider IDs. Use actual row_id values for reviews and outcomes.
onecrew.creator.candidate.batch.save takes one candidates array, up to 50; the eight-call envelope and provider concurrency are separate limits.
A link hub found in any profile is read with onecrew.link_hub.extract: links and emails return as found; nothing is saved until a Creator save confirms them.
Owner preparation reads fresh profiles and hubs, writes no Creator rows or reservations, and holds the immutable typed payload in the result owner.

operations.summary: Ask for missing information or preferences needed for the next decision. Ask one to four questions with two to four suggestions each; support single selection, multiple selection, and custom text. Reuse an existing plan or action confirmation instead of asking the same approval again.

Present result_ref for the user's App confirmation of the held payload without refetching, then read back saved Creators. Choice answers are not save authority.
Each confirmation authorizes one frozen call. Batches reuse result_ref for later reviews and keep completed receipts; only final status resumes the model.
Only onecrew.creator.export XLSX is canonical; map CSV or other sheets into explicit onecrew.creator.batch.create items and reject missing or ambiguous fields.
Owner statuses: eligible_new, eligible_update, existing_skipped, duplicate_skipped, identity_pending, contact_conflict, failed; count eligible_new toward a new Creator target.
identifier_semantics: OneCrew record IDs are durable local identities and are not provider handles.
Candidate explicit intent (add_new/save_or_update), target, connection, provenance, notes, tags and quality; batches use one intent and no candidate cache.
Historical discovery and candidate IDs stay provenance; current reads return provider IDs. Use actual row_id values for reviews and outcomes.
onecrew.creator.candidate.batch.save takes one candidates array, up to 50; the eight-call envelope and provider concurrency are separate limits.
A link hub found in any profile is read with onecrew.link_hub.extract: links and emails return as found; nothing is saved until a Creator save confirms them.
Owner preparation reads fresh profiles and hubs, writes no Creator rows or reservations, and holds the immutable typed payload in the result owner.

operations.summary: Ask for missing information or preferences needed for the next decision. Ask one to four questions with two to four suggestions each; support single selection, multiple selection, and custom text. The user reviews and submits answers once, then the task continues with those answers. This operation performs no business action. Reuse an existing plan or action confirmation instead of asking the same approval again.
operations.title: Ask the user a question

operations.summary: Archive one local Creator while preserving its record and return the updated state.
operations.title: Archive Creator

operations.summary: Create up to 50 explicit manual Creators, each with at most 16 initial contact routes, as atomic per-item writes after attended confirmation.
operations.title: Create Creator batch

operations.summary: Prepare up to 50 explicitly selected platform targets in one candidates array, including each candidate's explicit intent (add_new or save_or_update), target, connection, real provenance, optional notes, tags and quality. This is one business call; the MCP envelope's eight-call limit is separate. The owner obtains fresh platform data, presents the returned result_ref, and confirms rows and routes through onecrew_result_state. Preparation writes no Creator or reservation; confirmation consumes the prepared data without refetching or formatting it again.
operations.title: Prepare selected Creators for saving

operations.summary: Prepare one explicitly selected platform target with its explicit intent (add_new or save_or_update), connection, real provenance, optional notes, tags and quality. The owner obtains fresh platform data and presents the returned result_ref for confirmation through onecrew_result_state; the Agent need not prefetch a profile or channel solely for saving. Preparation saves no Creator. For several targets use onecrew.creator.candidate.batch.save.
operations.title: Prepare a selected Creator for saving

operations.summary: Run at most one budgeted read from durable approved scope. Complete each observed author through evidence, scoring and source-backed contacts before another author or platform search; read original-post identity before new X profiles, then deepen frozen keywords. Read the result before continuing; never blindly retry an uncertain local outcome.

operations.summary: Freeze one Campaign revision, platform profiles, hard criteria, and read budget.

operations.summary: Persist a bounded local draft; no provider read starts until explicit approval.

operations.summary: Read one durable Campaign, frozen criteria, budget, and platform checkpoints.

operations.summary: Count qualified, pending, and rejected candidates without counting search hits as qualified.

operations.summary: Read bounded candidate verdicts and source-backed evidence for one Campaign.
operations.title: List Campaign candidates

operations.summary: Read one author-bound Bilibili public-video receipt from local storage. No provider call and no qualification verdict.
operations.title: Read saved Campaign video evidence

operations.summary: Read bounded source hints saved by an approved Campaign search.
operations.title: List Campaign search hits

operations.summary: Read the budgeted X original-post author identity receipt from local storage. No provider call, historical identity backfill or qualification verdict.
operations.title: Read saved Campaign post-author identity

operations.summary: Read current evidence-validated account groups and independent member qualifications. Native-only groups do not prove distinct people.
operations.title: Read Campaign author groups

operations.summary: Read source-bound native account evidence for two saved hits. No provider call or identity decision.
operations.title: Read saved identity comparison material

operations.summary: Read an account-scoped immutable identity decision receipt before retrying an uncertain write.
operations.title: Read saved identity review

operations.summary: Append an authenticated correction to an existing identity decision. Preserve original evidence and independent member qualifications.
operations.title: Revoke an identity review

operations.summary: Record a citation-backed account relationship judgment using saved material and authenticated actor. Never infers identity from names or transfers qualification.
operations.title: Submit source-bound identity review

operations.summary: Check a model's proposed Campaign against the customer's exact sentence and current source registry; report unsupported or unquoted hard conditions without creating or approving anything.

operations.summary: Read native public author evidence and its budgeted completion or failure receipt. Local read only; not a qualification verdict.

operations.summary: Read a saved public-page receipt using the Campaign ID, candidate ID and exact requested URL returned by Campaign advance. Local-only: no provider call, budget consumption or qualification change. Preserve reading, completed and failed states and truncated evidence.

operations.summary: Read one account-scoped immutable review receipt by Campaign and request ID before retrying an uncertain submission. No provider call or qualification mutation.
operations.title: Read a saved Campaign review receipt

operations.summary: Submit citation-backed reviewer findings against the exact saved material hash. The authenticated account is injected by OneCrew; the owner determines and atomically stores the verdict. Does not send outreach.

operations.summary: Read bounded saved YouTube review material using Campaign ID, approved expected_revision and search_hit_id from search hits. operations.summary: Spend one frozen Campaign read call on a mapped OpenCLI creator platform and save bounded leads.

operations.summary: List current registered OpenCLI creator search entry points, browser requirements, profiles and bridge status. Registration does not prove provider login or search success.
operations.title: Get live discovery source inventory

operations.summary: Record an authenticated, idempotent decision to raise or lower the approved Campaign target while preserving frozen criteria, sources and read budget.
operations.title: Adjust discovery Campaign target

operations.summary: Read bounded timestamped source material and its durable failure or completion receipt. No provider call; not a qualification verdict.
operations.title: Read saved Campaign transcript

operations.summary: Spend one frozen Campaign read call through the connected OpenCLI profile and save bounded hits.
operations.title: Run one approved YouTube search

operations.summary: Spend one frozen Campaign read call on a saved video hit and persist candidate evidence.
operations.title: Read one Campaign YouTube hit

operations.summary: Fetch one public link-hub page found on any profile (Linktree and its peers) and return the outbound links and email addresses it publishes, as found, each with the page layer that surfaced it. Nothing is saved; classify what you keep when you save the Creator.
operations.title: Extract a link hub

operations.summary: Read the durable status and audit outcome of one prepared outreach action.
operations.title: Get outreach action status

operations.summary: Read the last operator account used for outbound contact on one saved route.
operations.title: Get a contact route's last outbound account

operations.summary: Classify one Creator route as resolved, blocked, unsupported, missing, or conflicting for the selected account.
operations.title: Resolve outreach contact target

operations.summary: Read one local outreach conversation and its recorded messages by conversation ID.
operations.title: Get a local outreach conversation

operations.summary: List locally recorded outreach conversations, newest activity first, with bounded pagination and optional channel, reply-state and name filters.
operations.title: List local outreach conversations

operations.summary: Read the live relationship state between the selected operator account and target.
operations.title: Get outreach relationship

operations.summary: Confirm external creator/content search criteria and keywords; no provider call or persisted plan. operations.summary: Mark one triage item acknowledged and return its updated local state.

gotchas: Ask user questions with onecrew.ask_user_question and consume completed answers once. Answers clarify intent; they do not approve an unrelated downstream write.
Do not merge identities from display names alone.
Present result_ref for the user's App confirmation of the held payload without refetching, then read back saved Creators. Choice answers are not save authority.
Each confirmation authorizes one frozen call. Batches reuse result_ref for later reviews and keep completed receipts; only final status resumes the model.
Only onecrew.creator.export XLSX is canonical; map CSV or other sheets into explicit onecrew.creator.batch.create items and reject missing or ambiguous fields.
Owner statuses: eligible_new, eligible_update, existing_skipped, duplicate_skipped, identity_pending, contact_conflict, failed; count eligible_new toward a new Creator target.
identifier_semantics: OneCrew record IDs are durable local identities and are not provider handles.
Candidate explicit intent (add_new/save_or_update), target, connection, provenance, notes, tags and quality; batches use one intent and no candidate cache.
Historical discovery and candidate IDs stay provenance; current reads return provider IDs. Use actual row_id values for reviews and outcomes.
onecrew.creator.candidate.batch.save takes one candidates array, up to 50; the eight-call envelope and provider concurrency are separate limits.
A link hub found in any profile is read with onecrew.link_hub.extract: links and emails return as found; nothing is saved until a Creator save confirms them.
Owner preparation reads fresh profiles and hubs, writes no Creator rows or reservations, and holds the immutable typed payload in the result owner.

operations.summary: Ask for missing information or preferences needed for the next decision. Ask one to four questions with two to four suggestions each; support single selection, multiple selection, and custom text. The user reviews and submits answers once, then the task continues with those answers. This operation performs no business action. Reuse an existing plan or action confirmation instead of asking the same approval again.

operations.summary: Archive one local Creator while preserving its record and return the updated state.

operations.summary: Prepare up to 50 explicitly selected platform targets in one candidates array, including each candidate's explicit intent (add_new or save_or_update), target, connection, real provenance, optional notes, tags and quality. This is one business call; the MCP envelope's eight-call limit is separate. The owner obtains fresh platform data, presents the returned result_ref, and confirms rows and routes through onecrew_result_state. Preparation writes no Creator or reservation; confirmation consumes the prepared data without refetching or formatting it again.

operations.summary: Prepare one explicitly selected platform target with its explicit intent (add_new or save_or_update), connection, real provenance, optional notes, tags and quality. Preparation saves no Creator. For several targets use onecrew.creator.candidate.batch.save.

toolkit_guides.connection_model: OneCrew records are local. Outreach derives its operator from the selected route or conversation; use each operation's exact input and connection contract.
gotchas: Ask user questions with onecrew.ask_user_question and consume completed answers once. Answers clarify intent; they do not approve an unrelated downstream write.
Do not merge identities from display names alone.
Present result_ref for the user's App confirmation of the held payload without refetching, then read back saved Creators. Choice answers are not save authority.
Each confirmation authorizes one frozen call. Batches reuse result_ref for later reviews and keep completed receipts; only final status resumes the model.
Only onecrew.creator.export XLSX is canonical; map CSV or other sheets into explicit onecrew.creator.batch.create items and reject missing or ambiguous fields.
Owner statuses: eligible_new, eligible_update, existing_skipped, duplicate_skipped, identity_pending, contact_conflict, failed; count eligible_new toward a new Creator target.
identifier_semantics: OneCrew record IDs are durable local identities and are not provider handles.
Candidate explicit intent (add_new/save_or_update), target, connection, provenance, notes, tags and quality; batches use one intent and no candidate cache.
Historical discovery and candidate IDs stay provenance; current reads return provider IDs. Use actual row_id values for reviews and outcomes.
onecrew.creator.candidate.batch.save takes one candidates array, up to 50; the eight-call envelope and provider concurrency are separate limits.
A link hub found in any profile is read with onecrew.link_hub.extract: links and emails return as found; nothing is saved until a Creator save confirms them.
Owner preparation reads fresh profiles and hubs, writes no Creator rows or reservations, and holds the immutable typed payload in the result owner.

operations.summary: Run at most one budgeted read from durable approved scope. Complete each observed author through evidence, scoring and source-backed contacts before another author or platform search; read original-post identity before new X profiles, then deepen frozen keywords. Identity alone never qualifies a creator. Stop on target, budget, busy or missing evidence; provider failures remain checkpoints. Read the result before continuing; never blindly retry an uncertain local outcome.

gotchas: Ask user questions with onecrew.ask_user_question and consume completed answers once. Answers clarify intent; they do not approve an unrelated downstream write.
Do not merge identities from display names alone.
Present result_ref for the user's App confirmation of the held payload without refetching, then read back saved Creators. Choice answers are not save authority.
Each confirmation authorizes one frozen call. Batches reuse result_ref for later reviews and keep completed receipts; only final status resumes the model.
Only onecrew.creator.export XLSX is canonical; map CSV or other sheets into explicit onecrew.creator.batch.create items and reject missing or ambiguous fields.
Owner statuses: eligible_new, eligible_update, existing_skipped, duplicate_skipped, identity_pending, contact_conflict, failed; count eligible_new toward a new Creator target.
identifier_semantics: OneCrew record IDs are durable local identities and are not provider handles.
Candidate explicit intent (add_new/save_or_update), target, connection, provenance, notes, tags and quality; batches use one intent and no candidate cache.
Historical discovery and candidate IDs stay provenance; current reads return provider IDs. Use actual row_id values for reviews and outcomes.
onecrew.creator.candidate.batch.save takes one candidates array, up to 50; the eight-call envelope and provider concurrency are separate limits.
A link hub found in any profile is read with onecrew.link_hub.extract: links and emails return as found; nothing is saved until a Creator save confirms them.
Owner preparation reads fresh profiles and hubs, writes no Creator rows or reservations, and holds the immutable typed payload in the result owner.

operations.summary: Ask for missing information or preferences needed for the next decision. toolkit_guides.connection_model: OneCrew records are local. Outreach derives its operator from the selected route or conversation; use each operation's exact input and connection contract.
gotchas: Ask user questions with onecrew.ask_user_question and consume completed answers once. Answers clarify intent; they do not approve an unrelated downstream write.
Do not merge identities from display names alone.
Present result_ref for the user's App confirmation of the held payload without refetching, then read back saved Creators. Choice answers are not save authority.
Each confirmation authorizes one frozen call. Batches reuse result_ref for later reviews and keep completed receipts; only final status resumes the model.
Only onecrew.creator.export XLSX is canonical; map CSV or other sheets into explicit onecrew.creator.batch.create items and reject missing or ambiguous fields.
Owner statuses: eligible_new, eligible_update, existing_skipped, duplicate_skipped, identity_pending, contact_conflict, failed; count eligible_new toward a new Creator target.
identifier_semantics: OneCrew record IDs are durable local identities and are not provider handles.
Candidate explicit intent (add_new/save_or_update), target, connection, provenance, notes, tags and quality; batches use one intent and no candidate cache.
Historical discovery and candidate IDs stay provenance; current reads return provider IDs. Use actual row_id values for reviews and outcomes.
onecrew.creator.candidate.batch.save takes one candidates array, up to 50; the eight-call envelope and provider concurrency are separate limits.
A link hub found in any profile is read with onecrew.link_hub.extract: links and emails return as found; nothing is saved until a Creator save confirms them.
Owner preparation reads fresh profiles and hubs, writes no Creator rows or reservations, and holds the immutable typed payload in the result owner.

operations.summary: Ask for missing information or preferences needed for the next decision. Ask one to four questions with two to four suggestions each; support single selection, multiple selection, and custom text. The user reviews and submits answers once, then the task continues with those answers. This operation performs no business action. Reuse an existing plan or action confirmation instead of asking the same approval again.

operations.summary: Archive one local Creator while preserving its record and return the updated state.

operations.summary: Prepare up to 50 explicitly selected platform targets in one candidates array, including each candidate's explicit intent (add_new or save_or_update), target, connection, real provenance, optional notes, tags and quality. This is one business call; the MCP envelope's eight-call limit is separate. The owner obtains fresh platform data, presents the returned result_ref, and confirms rows and routes through onecrew_result_state. Preparation writes no Creator or reservation; confirmation consumes the prepared data without refetching or formatting it again.

Preparation saves no Creator. For several targets use onecrew.creator.candidate.batch.save.

operations.summary: Ask for missing information or preferences needed for the next decision. Ask one to four questions with two to four suggestions each; support single selection, multiple selection, and custom text. The user reviews and submits answers once, then the task continues with those answers. This operation performs no business action. Reuse an existing plan or action confirmation instead of asking the same approval again.
operations.title: Ask the user a question

toolkit_guides.connection_model: OneCrew records are local. Outreach derives its operator from the selected route or conversation; use each operation's exact input and connection contract.
gotchas: Ask user questions with onecrew.ask_user_question and consume completed answers once. Answers clarify intent; they do not approve an unrelated downstream write.
Do not merge identities from display names alone.
Present result_ref for the user's App confirmation of the held payload without refetching, then read back saved Creators. Choice answers are not save authority.
Each confirmation authorizes one frozen call. Batches reuse result_ref for later reviews and keep completed receipts; only final status resumes the model.
Only onecrew.creator.export XLSX is canonical; map CSV or other sheets into explicit onecrew.creator.batch.create items and reject missing or ambiguous fields.
Owner statuses: eligible_new, eligible_update, existing_skipped, duplicate_skipped, identity_pending, contact_conflict, failed; count eligible_new toward a new Creator target.
identifier_semantics: OneCrew record IDs are durable local identities and are not provider handles.
Candidate explicit intent (add_new/save_or_update), target, connection, provenance, notes, tags and quality; batches use one intent and no candidate cache.
Historical discovery and candidate IDs stay provenance; current reads return provider IDs. Use actual row_id values for reviews and outcomes.
onecrew.creator.candidate.batch.save takes one candidates array, up to 50; the eight-call envelope and provider concurrency are separate limits.
A link hub found in any profile is read with onecrew.link_hub.extract: links and emails return as found; nothing is saved until a Creator save confirms them.
Owner preparation reads fresh profiles and hubs, writes no Creator rows or reservations, and holds the immutable typed payload in the result owner.

operations.summary: Ask for missing information or preferences needed for the next decision. Ask one to four questions with two to four suggestions each; support single selection, multiple selection, and custom text. The user reviews and submits answers once, then the task continues with those answers. This operation performs no business action. Reuse an existing plan or action confirmation instead of asking the same approval again.
operations.title: Ask the user a question

operations.summary: Archive one local Creator while preserving its record and return the updated state.
operations.title: Archive Creator

operations.summary: Create up to 50 explicit manual Creators, each with at most 16 initial contact routes, as atomic per-item writes after attended confirmation.
operations.title: Create Creator batch

operations.summary: Prepare up to 50 explicitly selected platform targets in one candidates array, including each candidate's explicit intent (add_new or save_or_update), target, connection, real provenance, optional notes, tags and quality. This is one business call; the MCP envelope's eight-call limit is separate. The owner obtains fresh platform data, presents the returned result_ref, and confirms rows and routes through onecrew_result_state. Preparation writes no Creator or reservation; confirmation consumes the prepared data without refetching or formatting it again.
operations.title: Prepare selected Creators for saving

operations.summary: Prepare one explicitly selected platform target with its explicit intent (add_new or save_or_update), connection, real provenance, optional notes, tags and quality. The owner obtains fresh platform data and presents the returned result_ref for confirmation through onecrew_result_state; the Agent need not prefetch a profile or channel solely for saving. operations.summary: Add one explicit contact route to a Creator and return the updated route record.

operations.summary: Classify provider identity evidence as new, exact, possible, or conflicting Creator matches.

operations.summary: List local Creator records with filters and bounded pagination.

operations.summary: Create a local Creator from explicit user-supplied identity and contact details.

operations.summary: Change one Creator's relationship stage and return the updated relationship.

operations.summary: Update editable fields on one local Creator and return the new revision.
operations.title: Update Creator

operations.summary: Run at most one budgeted read from durable approved scope. Complete each observed author through evidence, scoring and source-backed contacts before another author or platform search; read original-post identity before new X profiles, then deepen frozen keywords. Identity alone never qualifies a creator. Stop on target, budget, busy or missing evidence; provider failures remain checkpoints. Read the result before continuing; never blindly retry an uncertain local outcome.
operations.title: Advance approved discovery Campaign

operations.summary: Freeze one Campaign revision, platform profiles, hard criteria, and read budget.
operations.title: Approve discovery Campaign

operations.summary: Persist a bounded local draft; no provider read starts until explicit approval.
operations.title: Create discovery Campaign draft

operations.summary: Read one durable Campaign, frozen criteria, budget, and platform checkpoints.
operations.title: Get discovery Campaign

operations.summary: Count qualified, pending, and rejected candidates without counting search hits as qualified.
operations.title: Count Campaign candidates

operations.summary: Read bounded candidate verdicts and source-backed evidence for one Campaign.
operations.title: List Campaign candidates

operations.summary: Read one author-bound Bilibili public-video receipt from local storage. No provider call and no qualification verdict.
operations.title: Read saved Campaign video evidence

operations.summary: Read bounded source hints saved by an approved Campaign search.
operations.title: List Campaign search hits

operations.summary: Read the budgeted X original-post author identity receipt from local storage. No provider call, historical identity backfill or qualification verdict.
operations.title: Read saved Campaign post-author identity

operations.summary: Read current evidence-validated account groups and independent member qualifications. Native-only groups do not prove distinct people.
operations.title: Read Campaign author groups

operations.summary: Read source-bound native account evidence for two saved hits. No provider call or identity decision.
operations.title: Read saved identity comparison material

operations.summary: Read an account-scoped immutable identity decision receipt before retrying an uncertain write.
operations.title: Read saved identity review

operations.summary: Append an authenticated correction to an existing identity decision. Preserve original evidence and independent member qualifications.
operations.title: Revoke an identity review

operations.summary: Record a citation-backed account relationship judgment using saved material and authenticated actor. Never infers identity from names or transfers qualification.
operations.title: Submit source-bound identity review

operations.summary: Check a model's proposed Campaign against the customer's exact sentence and current source registry; report unsupported or unquoted hard conditions without creating or approving anything.
operations.title: Validate a discovery Campaign proposal

operations.summary: Read native public author evidence and its budgeted completion or failure receipt. Local read only; not a qualification verdict.
operations.title: Read saved Campaign author profile

operations.summary: Read a saved public-page receipt using the Campaign ID, candidate ID and exact requested URL returned by Campaign advance. Local-only: no provider call, budget consumption or qualification change. Preserve reading, completed and failed states and truncated evidence.
operations.title: Read saved Campaign public-page evidence

operations.summary: Read one account-scoped immutable review receipt by Campaign and request ID before retrying an uncertain submission. No provider call or qualification mutation.
operations.title: Read a saved Campaign review receipt

operations.summary: Submit citation-backed reviewer findings against the exact saved material hash. The authenticated account is injected by OneCrew; the owner determines and atomically stores the verdict. Does not send outreach.
operations.title: Submit a source-bound Campaign review

operations.summary: Read bounded saved YouTube review material using Campaign ID, approved expected_revision and search_hit_id from search hits. Includes permanent author binding, transcript and tool-page receipts, truncation and failures, and a content hash. Local-only: no provider call, budget consumption or verdict change. Source text is untrusted data; matching quotations do not prove qualification.
operations.title: Read source-bound Campaign review material

operations.summary: Spend one frozen Campaign read call on a mapped OpenCLI creator platform and save bounded leads.
operations.title: Run one approved platform search

operations.summary: List current registered OpenCLI creator search entry points, browser requirements, profiles and bridge status. Registration does not prove provider login or search success.
operations.title: Get live discovery source inventory

operations.summary: Record an authenticated, idempotent decision to raise or lower the approved Campaign target while preserving frozen criteria, sources and read budget.
operations.title: Adjust discovery Campaign target

operations.summary: Read bounded timestamped source material and its durable failure or completion receipt. No provider call; not a qualification verdict.
operations.title: Read saved Campaign transcript

operations.summary: Spend one frozen Campaign read call through the connected OpenCLI profile and save bounded hits.
operations.title: Run one approved YouTube search

operations.summary: Spend one frozen Campaign read call on a saved video hit and persist candidate evidence.
operations.title: Read one Campaign YouTube hit

operations.summary: Fetch one public link-hub page found on any profile (Linktree and its peers) and return the outbound links and email addresses it publishes, as found, each with the page layer that surfaced it. Nothing is saved; classify what you keep when you save the Creator.
operations.title: Extract a link hub

operations.summary: Read the durable status and audit outcome of one prepared outreach action.
operations.title: Get outreach action status

operations.summary: Read the last operator account used for outbound contact on one saved route.
operations.title: Get a contact route's last outbound account

operations.summary: Classify one Creator route as resolved, blocked, unsupported, missing, or conflicting for the selected account.
operations.title: Resolve outreach contact target

operations.summary: Read one local outreach conversation and its recorded messages by conversation ID.
operations.title: Get a local outreach conversation

operations.summary: List locally recorded outreach conversations, newest activity first, with bounded pagination and optional channel, reply-state and name filters.
operations.title: List local outreach conversations

operations.summary: Read the live relationship state between the selected operator account and target.
operations.title: Get outreach relationship

operations.summary: Confirm external creator/content search criteria and keywords; no provider call or persisted plan. Creator discovery ends in a candidate review card, not a write. confirmed_plan_ref expires 60 minutes after confirmation: page freely with next_cursor; changed criteria need a new confirmed plan. Skip only if the current user explicitly requests direct search.
operations.title: Prepare editable search plan

operations.summary: Mark one triage item acknowledged and return its updated local state.
operations.title: Acknowledge reply triage

operations.summary: List inbound replies awaiting triage with bounded pagination.
operations.title: List reply triage

operations.summary: Record one classification and recommended next action for an inbound reply.
operations.title: Record reply triage

operations.summary: Read-only Q&A guidance for finding creators and enriching profiles. Omit topic for a directory, or choose a registered scenario for questions, steps, discovery queries and examples. This does not execute business actions, send messages, or create scheduled work.
operations.title: Workflow guidance: find, enrich

toolkit_guides.purpose: Use OneCrew for durable Creator records, reviewed platform saves, confirmed contact routes, historical conversations, classifications, and revision-aware local changes.

operations.summary: Resolve a public username or a stable channel/supergroup identity through the selected operator session. Returns public community metadata without access hashes or saved Creator data.
operations.title: Read a Telegram community

operations.summary: Read the provider's current administrator page (up to 200 members) for a selected community. Returns public identity and role, without phone numbers or access hashes. A missing member is not proof of absence from the full community. Pass explicitly selected targets and real provenance to Creator save preparation; saving requires a separate review and confirmation.
operations.title: Read Telegram community administrators

toolkit_guides.connection_model: Provider work uses a tagged Telegram operator account. Login can continue through QR, phone code, OTP, or 2FA steps and may require a configured SOCKS5 proxy.
gotchas: Community search returns native public chat objects without a cursor or Creator snapshot. Use their real IDs and kinds to resolve a community and read administrators.
Administrator reads return a bounded page; a missing member does not prove absence. Prepare selected locators directly and present result_ref for App confirmation.
Continuation codes and passwords are transient secrets and must not be repeated in catalog queries.
After network_unreachable, run telegram.connection.check once and report its status; do not retry the failed call until the check returns ok.
identifier_semantics: Chat, channel, user, and message identifiers are distinct Telegram domains.
Carry identifiers returned by the selected Telegram account rather than guessing usernames.
telegram.community.get and telegram.community.administrators.list use current typed locators and return public data without phone numbers or access hashes.

pitfalls: Do not substitute phone login or expose the QR token outside its rendered handoff.

toolkit_guides.connection_model: Provider reads use a tagged YouTube service credential stored by the local vault; credential setup and rotation are separate lifecycle actions.
gotchas: Search returns native items and next_page_token, at most 50 per page. Repeated videos from one channel stay separate hits; each channel is described once in the channels map.
youtube.channel.get requires depth: light or full. Light omits comments and marks them omitted; full requests comments; unavailable sections mean the attempted read failed.
Read youtube.channel.get only when quality evidence is missing; otherwise pass channel ID, connection and provenance directly to Creator save preparation.
Before verification, deduplicate hits by stable channel ID across connections and read depths. Keep each source and provenance; do not merge names or unresolved handles.
API quota or credential validity can block reads; a channel handle is not a channel ID.
After network_unreachable, run youtube.connection.check once and report its status; do not retry the failed call until the check returns ok.
identifier_semantics: Channel IDs, video IDs, and handles are different locator forms.
Use the locator required by the exact selected operation schema.
